datasets.name: UAV remote-sensing data of Jiuzhaigou earthquake-triggered landslides
datasets.verbatim: The authors would like to thank the Sichuan Earthquake Administration for offering the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing data

methods.name: improved U-Net model
methods.summary: An improved U-Net architecture that incorporates six-channel input (RGB + DSM + slope + aspect) and adds residual learning units to both the up-sampling and down-sampling paths to enhance feature extraction and prevent gradient issues.
methods.source: Peng Liu, Yongming Wei, Qinjun Wang, Yu Chen, and Jingjing Xie
methods.verbatim: In order to solve the abovementioned problems and improve the efficiency of landslide identification, this paper proposes an automatic landslide identification method named improved U-Net model.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not referenced or linked, and the custom improved U-Net model code is not provided via a repository or persistent link.
